headerDisplay: Control an electromagnetic lock through a Raspberry Pi GPIO line connected to a relay. The lock always starts in the secured state.

lockPin.title: Lock GPIO line
lockPin.description: BCM GPIO / libgpiod line number, not the physical board pin

gpioChip.title: GPIO chip
gpioChip.description: libgpiod chip number; normally 0 on Raspberry Pi

activeLow.title: Relay is active-low
activeLow.description: Enable when GPIO value 0 activates the relay

unlockingDuration.title: Unlock duration
unlockingDuration.description: Seconds before the lock automatically secures again
